Austin.concept_name:
Diagnostic revealed a broken 3 wye in the kitchen under the foundation.
There is also another broken 4 wye at the exterior beam for the 3 compartment sink drain.
Plan of action is to apply for a permit with the customers jurisdiction to legally and professional proceed with repairs. - Begin by prepping the interior of the kitchen with either plastic or cardboard to help protect from construction dust. Then we will utilize specialized equipment to create a direct access entry hole located at the doorway into the kitchen . Then we will tunnel remove the soil to expose the broken 3wye.

Dallas.concept_name: ZO BC Interior alteration of an approximately 960-square-foot existing commercial space for a retail tobacco and vape store (BUZZ BROS LLC). Proposed retail layout includes an open sales area with seven merchandise display cases, a cashier counter, slat-wall product displays, four storage rooms, one additional room, a rear storage area, and a restroom. Retail merchandise will include tobacco products, electronic cigarettes, smoking accessories, snacks, beverages, and general merchandise. The proposed floor plan shows a minimum 36-inch clearance between displays and along designated aisles. Work includes arranging and installing retail display fixtures and preparing the interior space for retail operations.
